description: Sample food knowledge base for Food Guardian AI Agent

categories.name: Dairy & Eggs
categories.storage_tips: Store on middle shelves; avoid refrigerator door due to temperature fluctuations.

categories.name: Fruits & Vegetables
categories.storage_tips: Keep ethylene-producing fruits (e.g., bananas, apples) separate from ethylene-sensitive vegetables.

categories.name: Meat & Poultry
categories.storage_tips: Store on the bottom shelf in sealed containers to prevent cross-contamination.

categories.name: Pantry & Dry Goods
categories.storage_tips: Store in airtight containers in a cool, dark, dry place.

items.name: Whole Milk
items.waste_reduction_tips: Can be frozen before expiration for use in baking or cooking.

items.name: Fresh Spinach
items.waste_reduction_tips: Wilted spinach can still be used in soups, stews, or smoothies.

items.name: Eggs
items.waste_reduction_tips: Use older eggs for hard-boiling as they peel more easily.

items.name: Chicken Breast
items.waste_reduction_tips: Freeze immediately if not cooking within 48 hours.
